 Match Preview
 UEFA Nations League B - Game Week 5 14 Nov 2026 - 13:45 Strawberry Arena Sweden host Bosnia and Herzegovina at Strawberry Arena in Stockholm in UEFA Nations League B Group 4, with both sides knowing exactly what is at stake in this fixture.
 Graham Potter's Sweden sit top of the group heading into this match, having picked up three wins from their last four Nations League outings. Their most recent outing ended in a 1-0 win over Romania, and they have been clinical at home throughout this campaign.
 Bosnia and Herzegovina arrive in second place, making this a genuine top-of-the-table contest in Group 4. Sergej Barbarez's side have been difficult to beat, going unbeaten in three of their last four Nations League matches, including a 1-0 win over Poland and a 4-2 victory against Romania.
 The two sides met earlier in this Nations League campaign, drawing 1-1 in Zenica in October. That result means Sweden will be motivated to settle the score on home soil and extend their lead at the summit.
 Tarik Muharemovic will miss the match for Bosnia and Herzegovina through suspension, which could prove significant against a Sweden attack that has been in sharp form.
